programs.title: Weekend Breakfast
programs.desc: All the news you need to start your weekend. Fauziah Ibrahim and Johanna Nicholson bring you the latest news, interviews, politics, culture, weather and global affairs. Plus sport with Jared Coote.

programs.title: rage Charts
programs.desc: Keep the party vibe going every Saturday morning with wall-to-wall music videos, from classic hits and long-forgotten tracks from the rage vault, to the latest new releases and special features.

programs.title: Rage: Guest Programmer
programs.desc: Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. Guest programmers curate an all-night playlist of their all-time favourite clips.

programs.title: ABC News At Noon
programs.desc: Melissa Mackay presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information.

programs.title: Death In Paradise
programs.desc: Mervin and the team pull together to pin down the prime suspect in his mother's murder. But old wounds are reopened as Mervin is forced to confront his past.

programs.title: Shetland
programs.desc: Calder and Tosh discover the truth behind Rossi's mission. They must identify Annie's killer before he can exact his revenge.

programs.title: Shanghai Symphony Orchestra
programs.desc: From the Sydney Opera House Concert Hall, Maestro Long Yu conducts the Shanghai Symphony Orchestra in a thrilling concert featuring acclaimed cellist Jian Wang, performing Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninov.

programs.title: Stuff The British Stole
programs.desc: Marc Fennell unpacks how a celebrated explorer ended up in Hawaii and why a detour, a broken mast, and a clash over sacred wood spiralled into Captain Cook's violent demise.

programs.title: Australian Story
programs.desc: When Richard Scolyer was diagnosed with brain cancer three years ago, he volunteered to undergo risky, new treatment, hoping for a medical breakthrough. As we filmed in his final months, he reflects on his life and legacy.

programs.title: Landline
programs.desc: A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

programs.title: Kath & Kim
programs.desc: Kim's cabbage diet has an unexpected side effect: flatulence. Kel and Kath star in The Hours - The Musical directed by the intense and demanding Robyn Robinson. Robyn seems to have it in for Kath.

programs.title: Hard Quiz
programs.desc: Hard Quiz: it's the quiz show so big that OTHER quiz show hosts turn up in the questions! Vying for Tom's Big Brass Mug are experts in the Phantom, Love Actually, Republican China, and.Eddie McGuire!
